name: com.stefanwebb.voiceagents
description: Build AI voice agents in Unity that run fully locally. Connects to local speech-to-text and LLM chat servers over named pipes and exposes their events on a lightweight event bus.

samples.description: Sample scene: press Space to speak, Enter to confirm the transcription, and the LLM replies. Requires the named-pipe stt and chat servers to be running.
